reason: I'd use the free visit for sure, and a safe gated spot for my 10-month-old is a real draw. After that I'd maybe pay for one weekday visit, but $13 plus $7 for the baby adds up fast on my budget.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee, and $20 a visit for two kids is a lot when the library and free playgrounds exist.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper two-kid price, like $15 total for both, or a bigger discount on the 5-visit pack for siblings.
